rubric.evidence: Corrected three factual errors against the HTML Standard (attr-template-for, find markers, prepare content patching; read 2026-11-15) and Chromium M148 source (branch 7778 patch.cc, html_template_element.idl, runtime_enabled_features.json5): markers are <?marker name=..>/<?start name=..>/<?end>, not <?start id?>/<?end id?>; Chrome 148 is 'In developer trial (Behind a flag)' (milestone-148 listing), not enabled by default; ship is 150. Severity records the pre-upgrade errors.

Feature 5111042975465472 is in the milestone=148 listing under 'In developer trial (Behind a flag)' and in milestone=150 under 'Enabled by default' (queried 2026-11-15); v148 route is correct; warn-block now gives exact enable steps.

Inventory grew from 4 to 6 items (added <?marker> point marker and htmlFor IDL); formal syntax (verbatim IDL + marker grammar) and a processing-model section cover the parser algorithm. Single overview page; no child routes needed for this size of surface.

Examples rewritten to the standard syntax, plus the HTML Standard's <?marker> select example and an htmlFor feature-detect snippet; template-slots-demo concept embedded (HEAD 200 2026-11-15). Examples not executed in a flagged Chrome 148.

BCD table from html.elements.template.for / api.HTMLTemplateElement.htmlFor / api.ProcessingInstruction.doc_html (Chrome 150, Edge mirror, Firefox/Safari false); webstatus.dev template-for 'limited' banner; 148 flag noted from Chromium source because BCD omits it.
Banner role=note+aria-label, compat region tabindex/role/aria-labelledby caption, th scope, iframe title + figcaption.

Headless Chrome (Playwright) 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3: scrollWidth==clientWidth on both after adding overflow-wrap to warn-block code (the long --enable-blink-features value initially pushed mobile to 473px). Screenshots read: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-gendn/4af6118d-eb58-5a13-90bd-f2c21f2fb9fa/scratchpad/ooo-desktop-top.png, ooo-mobile-compat.png, ooo-desktop-embed.png, ooo-mobile-embed.png.

Manifest demo unchanged (feature index URL is the first own-feature showcase link, placed before the template-slots-demo iframe); four sibling concepts linked. Showcase demo itself prints an escaped '<template for>' literal in its note (CPS bug, not gendn).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table without horizontal page overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic <table> with <thead>/<th>, wrap in a scroll container with tabindex=0, role=region and an accessible name (aria-labelledby a caption); keep short cells on one line instead of crushing columns.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied to the new compat table: caption + aria-labelledby region wrapper with tabindex=0, thead/tbody, scope=col/row, nowrap browser/version columns; house .table-wrap scroller kept (sticky headers and stacked-card transform excepted: 4-row table, house pattern is the scroller).

guidanceConsulted.query: lazy loaded third-party iframe embed sandbox performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Control what third-party subresources receive (referrer policy) and limit their capabilities.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase iframe carries sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin" + referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" (house gendn-kjq posture), loading=lazy, a title and a figcaption.

guidanceConsulted.query: status banner note landmark accessible label
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML and give non-heading regions an accessible name; do not convey state by colour alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: Baseline banner is role=note with aria-label; limited browsers use a dashed border AND the text 'not shipped'/'no signal', not colour alone; shared .baseline-banner--paper-compact variant reused (CSS variables, no raw hex).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive callout banner warning box long code wrapping mobile overflow accessible table
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid horizontal overflow from long unbreakable flag tokens on narrow viewports by keeping overflow-wrap:anywhere on inline code rather than clipping.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied (2026-11-27): added data-shipped-in="150" to .warn-block, linked ChromeStatus 5111042975465472, Intent to Ship, and /v150/out-of-order-streaming/, updated eyebrow and flag wording, and verified .warn-block code wrapping.

openQuestions: The showcase template-slots-demo simulates slot filling with JavaScript per its own note; it does not prove native patching in Chrome 148.

followUpGoals.goal: Run the examples in Chrome 148 with --enable-blink-features=DocumentPatching,HTMLProcessingInstruction and record observed behaviour (especially <?end> nesting and head patching).
